retainedVerbatim: Sources/FluidAudio except the adapted and added files listed below

adapted.Package.swift: Library-only distribution: removes development CLI/tests/dependencies, retains original runtime wrappers, resources, and pinned NemoTextProcessing binary URL/checksum.
adapted.Sources/FluidAudio/Diarizer/Offline/Core: Retains immutable preparation configuration for same-run evidence validation.

Adds clusterWithEvidence, caller-isolated completed-real-window extraction, bounded original-threshold AHC evidence partitions for live anchoring, and cancellation propagation/draining. Live partitions intentionally do not use small-cohort VBx pruning, which can transfer absent anchors to new voices. Original offline cluster API, AHC/VBx algorithms, thresholds, and quality defaults are retained.
adapted.Sources/FluidAudio/Diarizer/Offline/Segm: Optional windowLimit bounds completed-window scheduling to one real window; existing callers retain original offset scheduling.
adapted.Sources/FluidAudio/Speaker/CampPlusModel: Adds explicit embedding compute-unit overload so live loading excludes GPU. Original load(from:) API and offline CPU/GPU default remain unchanged; preprocessing remains CPU-only.

added.Sources/FluidAudio/Diarizer/Offline/Core: Public read-only same-invocation segmentation, extraction masks, vectors and cluster assignments; no production @testable access.
Read-only complete-window extraction rows with immutable run/row UUIDs and bounded cohort assignment receipt; construction remains SDK-internal.

modelProvenance: Separate CC-BY-4.0 pinned model receipt/card/attribution in Packages/TranscriptCore/Sources/TranscriptCore/Resources. No model weights are vendored here.
